credit: CreateTrainNext 5-light signal — the halo drawn over a lit lamp. One voxel square and centred on the model origin rather than on a lamp socket, because the renderer scales it about that origin: at origin the scale factor is the halo's width in voxels, and the renderer then moves it onto whichever socket is lit. Flat, single-faced and thin; the additive render type it is drawn with does not cull, so the one face is enough.
